_comment: POST-HOC AMENDMENT, 2026-10-04 ~09:45 UTC, written after seeing ONLY the 16 serial (N=1) production runs, before any N >= 4 rung or any FR arm of the ladder was scored.
observation: Seed-pooled serial ABF (16 seeds x 1.2288e8 steps) has e_F = 0.0763 vs the v2 TI reference, equal to the single-seed median 0.0759 -> a deterministic bias, not noise. The difference profile is a step of ~0.16 kT across the trough (z 0.1-0.4: dF +0.12 at z <= 0.1, -0.04..-0.08 for z >= 0.4). Windowed estimates from t > 1000 tu agree with each other within noise (0.003-0.013), all ~0.075 from the reference, i.e. the dynamics converge to a stationary profile that the reference does not match. Any converged arm therefore floors at ~0.076 against the v2 reference, while short (N = 1024, T = 240) runs can read below it (accepted FR 0.045): the floor would favour many-replica arms in an equal-budget ladder (the gateway's class-9 trap, reversed).
remedy: an independent dynamics-consistent reference: 32 serial ABF runs, seeds 3400-3431 (used by NO compared arm), full budget 1.2288e8 steps each, two ABF arms per job at 160 and 640 bins (the 640-bin arm tests that the trough step is not a histogram-resolution artefact). Reference = pooled 160-bin accumulators at u = 1 -> accepted pmf_profile; its own noise is estimated by a seed-half split.
reporting: both scorings are reported: v2 TI reference (preregistered) and dynamics-consistent reference (post-hoc, labelled). The validation gate (numba vs accepted) uses the v2 reference only.
